_note: Entry and exit rules shown on the research page. {name} is filled from the live registry value of that parameter, so the text always matches what the strategy runs with.

entry: Daily: the {fast_period}-day average is above the {slow_period}-day average (long), or below it (short).
The slow average has moved at least {minimum_slope_pct} over the last 5 sessions in the same direction.
exit: Trailing stop {trailing_stop_pct} once the trade is {trailing_activation_pct} in profit.
Trend reversal, after {minimum_hold_sessions} sessions. Forced exit after {maximum_holding_sessions} sessions.

entry: Each day the universe is ranked on 5-, 10- and 20-day returns.
Buys the top {top_n} names if the gap between the best and worst score is at least {minimum_score_spread}, and the name's own return is at least {minimum_time_series_return}.
exit: Rebalanced daily: a name leaves when it drops out of the top ranks, after {minimum_hold_sessions} sessions.

entry: Daily: the close is at least {stretch_pct} below its {lookback_days}-day mean on each of the last {minimum_stretch_days} sessions (short: above it).
RSI(14) is at or below {long_rsi_max} (short: at or above {short_rsi_min}).

Slope filter ({slope_mode}): fixed_pct blocks a {slope_lookback_days}-session slope above {max_reference_slope_pct}; volatility_scaled blocks a slope above {slope_volatility_multiple} daily sigmas; off skips it.
Efficiency-ratio filter ({regime_filter}): with er, names whose {efficiency_ratio_period}-day efficiency ratio is above {efficiency_ratio_max} (a smooth trend) are skipped.
The last close is above the close before it (short: below).
exit: The stretch reverts to {mean_target_fraction} of the way back to the mean, a hard stop, or the {maximum_holding_sessions}-session limit.

entry: Each day the universe is scored on momentum, low volatility, short-term reversal and value and quality factors.
Holds the top {top_n} names long and the bottom {top_n} short, with equal weights, subject to sector neutrality.
exit: Rebalanced daily. A name leaves when it drops out of its side, after {minimum_hold_sessions} sessions.

entry: An LLM reads the news and returns a buy or sell with confidence. It trades only at confidence {minimum_confidence} or above.
exit: Stops as set in the settings file for this strategy.

entry: On 5-minute bars the {fast_period}-bar average crosses above the {slow_period}-bar average (short: below).
exit: Trend reversal, a stop, or a forced exit three sessions after entry.

entry: The price is above its session average, and the {lookback}-bar return is at least {minimum_return}.
Volume is at least {minimum_volume_ratio} times its average.
exit: Momentum turns negative, a stop, or a forced exit three sessions after entry.

entry: Continuously, on 5-minute bars: the reference is the average close of the last 21 bars.
Slope filter: the reference may move at most {max_reference_slope_pct} over the last 5 bars, so a steep trend is not faded.

Dip: the price is at least {minimum_dip_pct} below the reference, closing above the previous close after a higher low, with a bounce of at least {minimum_bounce_pct} off the low. Spike: the mirror image, at least {minimum_rip_pct} above it.
Efficiency-ratio filter (when set to er): smooth trends are skipped. Volume is at least {minimum_volume_ratio} times its average, and entries are capped per day.
exit: The price is back at the 21-bar average, a stop, or a forced exit three sessions after entry.
